text_block_list.text: Whoa! She came in first again!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Yeeeaaah! You're the best, Falco! The
greatest
Umadol there is!
text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A

text_block_list.text: She might actually win every race!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Goooo, Falcooooo!
text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A

text_block_list.text: Goooo, Falco!
text_block_list.name: Spectators A and B

text_block_list.text: Oh... Yeah.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But it's not enough. It doesn't feel
anything like that
day...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
There's got to be a way to make the
concerts even
better...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Oh.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Well...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's just, I can't afford to sit back and
relax
just yet.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
There are still more races out there I
have to win!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Next up is the JBC Classic. I imagine
rivals are
going to start showing up
looking to take me
down soon enough.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: But I won't go down without a fight!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
As soon as she says that, an unexpected
visitor
appears.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: W-wait, aren't you...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: The student council president?!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон, please pardon the
intrusion. I know
you've just finished
running.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's Симболи Рудольф, the student council
president
of Академия Тайсен. With a
whopping seven
crowns under her belt,
she will certainly go down
in history.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Um, is something the matter? I'm not in
trouble...
am I?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Is this about me passing out flyers from
the rooftop? Or
performing in the staff
room? Oh no, I don't even know
where
to start...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Haha, there's no need to be concerned.
As a
matter of fact, I am here to applaud
your efforts.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
First, I would like to give you my
congratulations.
Followed by... my
heartfelt appreciation.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
As president of the student council, I've
been
alerted to your rising popularity.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The dirt scene has been abuzz since you
made
your announcement. Attendance,
engagement...
All the figures have been
on the rise.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As someone who deeply wishes for the
prosperity
of all Umamusume, and as an
Umamusume
myself...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I would like to express my sincerest
gratitude for
all your hard work. I'm
looking forward to even
more
exceptional performances.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I-I'll do my best!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it... The president herself
thanked
me personally...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: That's proof of how successful you've been.

text_block_list.text: Huh... I guess so.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
If so, that only means more work for me!
I want to
live up to her expectations!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон is brimming with positivity
after
receiving Симболи Рудольф's
compliments.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But it's not enough. It doesn't feel
anything like that
day...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The race has left her a little too worked
up for my
liking, but now's not the time
to put a damper on
things. With that in
mind...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Let's win the JBC Classic next!

text_block_list.text:
That goes without saying! ☆ I don't have
any
other choice!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna give it my all! Wooo! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
